info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Routing Decisions API
info.description: The Routing Decisions API facilitates the determination and management of routing decisions in market data operations. This endpoint allows users to submit and update routing configurations based on market conditions and business logic. Typical consumers include financial institutions and trading platforms that require dynamic routing capabilities to optimize market data handling. Leveraging this API can enhance decision-making and improve data processing efficiency across various banking applications.

post.summary: Create a new routing decision for market data switch operations.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new routing decision specifically for market data switch operations. By providing the necessary data in the request body, users can effectively manage how market data is routed based on predefined rules and criteria.
